name: controlled-document-pdf-agent
description: Controlled Document PDF Agent: create a ComplianceQuest Controlled Document from a PDF, or compare a new PDF with an existing document and summarize the differences.

scripts.validate: sf project deploy validate --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests DocPdfAgentTest DocPdfExtractionTest DocPdfCompareTest
scripts.deploy: sf project deploy start --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests DocPdfAgentTest DocPdfExtractionTest DocPdfCompareTest
scripts.test: sf apex run test --class-names DocPdfAgentTest DocPdfExtractionTest DocPdfCompareTest --result-format human --code-coverage --wait 10
